category.reason: Several parking results use identical booking buttons. The task requires matching the requested parking facility to its listing and locating the button in that listing.

instruction.en: Find the “Book online” button in the listing for LAZ Parking’s 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge Garage.
instruction.zh: 在 LAZ Parking 的 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge Garage 结果中，找到 “Book online” 按钮。
